ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Propaganda This course will investigate the meaning, history and techniques of propaganda from a communicative perspective, focusing on data regarding the use of propaganda in Europe and the US. Although we will discuss different types of propaganda and various areas of its use, we will focus on political propaganda. Besides the participatory discussion and interpretation of the main concepts of propaganda based on the daily readings from a principal text and some additional readings, there will also be content analysis of different medial texts and viewing of films and documentaries.
